title: Waiting for Godot
author: Samuel Beckett
summary: Two tramps, Vladimir and Estragon, wait by a bare tree for someone named Godot who never arrives, passing the time with banter and visits from the domineering Pozzo and his servant Lucky.
readIf: you enjoy absurdist theatre, bleak humour and open questions.
skipIf: you want a plot with events or resolution.
